business_summary: Troy Information Technology Co., Ltd. engages in big data and artificial intelligence businesses in China. The company offers Turbolinux Server Operating System; Embedded Operating System; Secure Database (Centralized) GreatDB Enterprise; Secure Database (Distributed) GreatDB Cluster; TDATA computer storage; 5G system products, including 5G extended pico base stations, micro base stations, lightweight 5G core networks, and 5G smart industrial gateways; and Secure Data Backup and Recovery Software. It also provides IoT sensing platform it connects to various devices, adapts to diverse network environments and common transmission protocols, and enables unified access and management of various sensing terminal devices; data integration platform, a technical platform for centralized data storage; and Video Fusion, which allows access to multiple formats, protocols, and device types to achieve video aggregation capabilities. In addition, the company offers DevOps capability platform; big data platform; intelligent big data fusion platform; MLOps AI capability platform; AI algorithm supermarket; cloud-edge integrated intelligent platform; generative intelligent cognition platform; data governance platform; data sharing and exchange platform; and data visualization platform. Further, it provides digital innovation products comprising smart city and social governance, intelligent environmental monitoring unit, smart park, digital village, smart substation, smart distribution room, 5G high-precision positioning solution, 5G smart factory, 5G low-orbit satellite communication products, 5G+ smart mine solutions, storage-compute separation & multi-master architecture joint innovation solution, and high-speed railway station platform end security system. Troy Information Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1996 and is based in Chengdu, China.
